info.description: Algorithmic contest platform REST API & judge engine.
info.title: MiniAlgothon API

get.description: Fetch paginated administrative and security audit events.

parameters.description: Filter by status (success, failure, locked, blocked)
parameters.name: status

post.description: Immediately terminate the contest and set status to ENDED.
Add additional minutes to the active contest duration.
Manually freeze the leaderboard standings at the current moment.
Pause the active contest timer.
Reset contest lifecycle back to NOT_STARTED.
Resume a paused contest.

put.description: Update contest title, duration, and scoreboard freeze window.

post.description: Start the contest timer immediately with given or default duration.
Manually unfreeze the leaderboard standings to reveal live scores.

get.description: Every panel the proctoring console shows, in one call: fleet overview, agent heartbeats, risk rollups and enrollments. Sections run concurrently and are selected with `include`.

parameters.description: Telemetry filter: ONLINE, STALE, OFFLINE or GAP
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Telemetry filter: match username or display name
parameters.name: q

get.description: Fetch all problems including draft and published problems.

post.description: Create a new contest problem with metadata, sample test cases, and optional evaluation test cases.

get.description: Fetch full problem details by ID for editing.

put.description: Update existing problem statement, limits, sample testcases, and optional evaluation test cases.

delete.description: Delete a problem and all associated test cases.

patch.description: Publish or unpublish a problem for contest visibility.

get.description: Fetch test case metadata for a problem (does not transmit full bodies).

put.description: Replace official evaluation test cases for a problem.

post.description: Add an evaluation test case with input and expected output (supports multipart up to 20MB or JSON).

get.description: Download all test cases for a problem bundled as a ZIP archive.
get.summary: Admin Export All Problem Test Cases as ZIP

patch.description: Update point values for multiple test cases.

put.description: Update an existing test case's input, expected output, or points.

delete.description: Delete a test case and re-sequence remaining ordinals.

get.description: Download raw expected output file/content for a single test case.
get.summary: Admin Get Single Test Expected Content

get.description: Download raw input file/content for a single test case.
get.summary: Admin Get Single Test Input Content

get.description: Enrollment history and liveness per competitor, including revoked enrollments.

post.description: Invalidate an agent credential, forcing a fresh enrollment on that machine.

get.description: Fetch evidence findings for a specific competitor.
Fleet-wide agent liveness counts and any open telemetry incident.
Fetch risk scores, severities, and finding counts for all competitors.
One ordered axis of telemetry events, blackouts, findings, submissions and enrolments.

post.description: Administrator clears the exit lockout and allows contestant to re-enroll or re-enter competition.
Accept or reject a judged submission.
Atomically create a team with optional member user accounts.
post.summary: Admin Create Team with Optional Members

get.description: Fetch live agent telemetry and liveness for competitor accounts.

parameters.description: Filter by ONLINE, STALE or OFFLINE
parameters.name: status

get.description: Fetch all user accounts and team assignments.

post.description: Create a single user account.
Bulk create competitor user accounts.

patch.description: Grant or revoke browser fallbacks for one competitor.
Grant or revoke proctoring exemption for a user.

post.description: Reset user password and invalidate all active sessions.

patch.description: Temporarily block or unblock user access.

post.description: Exchange contestant credentials for a long-lived agent credential.
Replay heartbeats an agent buffered while the server was unreachable.
Report endpoint signals and agent liveness.

get.description: Fetch cadences and detection denylists so organizers can tune them without rebuilding clients.

post.description: Record a deliberate stop so the blackout is not read as evasion.
Authenticate user with username and password, creating a server-side session.
Delete current server-side session token.

get.description: Fetch the current contest lifecycle state, countdown timer, and server timestamp.
Retrieve team leaderboard ranked by best scores per problem with freeze metadata.
Fetch authenticated user profile details and team info.

post.description: Update user's own password after verifying current credentials.

get.description: Fetch list of published contest problems for competitors.
Fetch detailed problem statement and sample testcases by problem slug.
Full disclosure of what the proctor agent collects, shown before enrollment.

post.description: Execute code against sample test cases or custom stdin in an isolated sandbox.

get.description: List submissions made by current user or team.

post.description: Queue code submission for official contest judging.

get.description: Server-Sent Events stream for real-time submission progress and result pushes.
Fetch evaluation verdict and test results by submission ID.

post.description: Ingest client-side browser proctoring violations (e.g. fullscreen exits, window blur, tab switch, devtools attempt).
Contestant voluntarily leaves the competition session. This revokes active agent enrollment and locks submission access until re-admitted by an admin.

get.description: Report the contestant's own agent liveness so the portal can warn them while they still have time to fix it. Recording the caller's browser presence is a side effect of the poll.

parameters.description: Whether the portal tab was foregrounded when polled
parameters.name: tab_visible

get.description: Check backend database connection and API service health status.

errors.description:
Sections that failed, by name. One dead panel must not blank a console
somebody is running a contest from.
